The archive riddle

Four digits. One way out.

The code uses four different digits. It does not begin with zero. Each row gives an exact count. Any other digits in that row are absent from the code.

3408Two digits belong. Both are in the wrong places.
4820Three digits belong. All three are in the wrong places.
1672Two digits belong. One is in the right place; one is in the wrong place.
0274All four digits belong. Every one is in the wrong place.
